purpose: Defines the frozen lld.v1 ModuleBrief/FreezeRecord shape and hand-mirrored TS+Python validators shared by U2-U5.

acceptance.when: validateModuleBrief and validate_module_brief both parse it
acceptance.then: apps/mobile/src/build/lld-v1.ts's validator agrees with the Python mirror on the same verdict

non_goals: Does not implement an ajv or JSON-Schema-runtime validator
Does not implement the lld-ready gate's business-rule checks (that is U3)

guarantees.claim: the schema never lets a proposer author an authority field
guarantees.label: kills_structural

guarantees.claim: content_hash is stable across field reordering

derivation.calc: 100 key-order shuffles produced 1 distinct hash = 100/100 stable

guarantees.label: kills_mechanical

alternatives.option: adopt ajv for JSON-Schema-backed runtime validation
alternatives.why_killed: adds a runtime dependency no package.json here lists and no other Orb module uses yet
alternatives.revive_trigger: a second consumer needs full draft-07 keyword support beyond hand-written field checks

alternatives.option: generate the Python validator from the JSON Schema at build time
alternatives.why_killed: no codegen step exists in this repo's build; a hand-mirror plus the conformance test is the smaller diff
alternatives.revive_trigger: a third language needs the same schema

failure_story.trigger: the Python and TypeScript validators drift after an edit lands in only one of them
failure_story.blast_radius: the client accepts a brief the relay silently rejects, or vice versa, and a freeze attempt fails opaquely deep in the pipeline
failure_story.fail_safe: test_lld_schema_conformance.py runs both validators against the same fixtures on every CI run and fails loud on any mismatch
